name: Securing the Lines
objectiveText: Kill 12 Dustwind Savages and 8 Dustwind Storm Witches for Rezlak near Drygulch Ravine.   Dustwind Savage slain  ( 12 )   Dustwind Storm Witch slain  ( 8 )

comments.body:
Ok, no ones discription here was very well done so! Im going to hopefully help out.....

If you are going through the caynon heading from Orgrimmar the entrance to the little valley that leads to the cave will be on your left right by the broken down wagons... 50.29 .... go left you will see the cave on your right thats where you will find the mobs for this quest hope I helped!
This quest can also be completed by the Alliance.
replies: If you dare......signed The Horde dueling outside of Org.

comments.body: This quest can be tough to get to if you don't know the area.  Run into Drygulch Ravine and kill the harpies until you get to the end.  Go through the cave and it puts you where you want to be.  After that, all you have to do is commite Harpy Genocide until you have filled your quota.  When you complete this quest, you get a good chunk of XP and a pretty decent weapon.  (If you haven't bough one off the AH yet)
There is an entrance to Dry Gulch directly east of his camp - dustrunner harpy types are along there but further in are the ones u want.

I noticed quite a few Copper Mines during this quest for those interested in lvling their mining profession! =)  GL
~warbabe, dragonblight server
Can be found at 53,27 that'll get you started.
The entrance is NOT just east of Margoz' camp - try south, and a little west at those coordinates (53,27) or (54,27).
replies:
The entrance IS just east of Rezlak's camp, you can get to it in two different ways.  Either go straight east from his camp, across the road to the first entrance south and go straight south to the cave.  Or, go south down the road until you get to the passage to the east, go in there and turn south.

Once you pass through the cave, you'll be at the harpies you seek.

for people who dont have cords, head to where the harpies are like in the previous quest n go further in

replies: I got (51, 27) but then I was standing in the zone. The entrance is not too obvious; it looks like rocky arch with a tunnel. Go through it to get to the higher-level Harpy area. Oh, and confirm that Alliance can do this; I got good Ratchet reputation: 250 for this and a like amount for the previous one, plus 700 XP for this one.
